result.explanation: A bounded retry state machine tracks one current job, its attempt, phase, deadline, and logical time. Matching responses mutate only the active pending attempt; stale responses are ignored. Waiting retries activate once when advance reaches the deadline.
result.mapping: The source rule directly maps config.attempts and config.delay to retry limits and deadlines, state fields to lifecycle state, and event types to transitions and output status.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the published shape and safe-integer bounds. Only the current event and returned JSON state are used.
